# Alexander Gellert — Indie Game Developer & Tiny Heart Studios
> Portfolio, Mobile & Web Games, Game Development Blog and Market Analytics.

## Summary
Alexander Gellert (Tiny Heart Studios) is an independent game developer specializing in mobile, 3D, and web game development using Defold, Godot 4, and Web technologies.

## Official Links
- Main Website: https://a-gellert.github.io/
- Blog & Devlogs: https://a-gellert.github.io/blog/
- Game Trends Analytics Dashboard: https://a-gellert.github.io/trends/
- Telegram Channel: https://t.me/tiny_game (@tiny_game)
- Developer Email: oblistud@gmail.com

## Published Games & Projects
- Smash Arena (Defold, PvP Action Arena) on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=best.pvp.smasharena.battle
- Numbert: Brain Puzzles (Defold, Math & Logic IQ Trainer) on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=brain.puzzles.iq.braintraining.math.logictrainer
- Ragdoll Destruction Playground (Physics Sandbox) on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Ragdoll.Playground.Sandbox.Physics.RagdollDestructionPlayground
- Master Of 3 Tiles (Mahjong / Tile Matching) on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tinyheartstudios.brainstorm
- Perimeter Survival (Godot 4, 3D Forest Shelter Survival) on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ths.survival.forest.shelter.monsters

## Blog Categories
- Дневник разработки (Devlog): Technical deep dives into netcode, physics, architecture.
- Как сделать (How-to): Guides on mobile optimization, 3D rendering in Godot 4, procedural puzzle generation.
- Ассеты (Assets): Shaders, VFX, open-source resources for game developers.
- Аналитика (Analytics): Market trends across Steam, Google Play, Poki, CrazyGames, and Yandex Games.
